The S&P 500 rose 1.08%, while the Nasdaq gained 1.91%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.14%. Bitcoin (BTC) fell about 2% over the past 24 hours and is trading just above $63,000 at press time. Markets came under pressure Wednesday after the Federal Reserve's first policy meeting led by Warsh. Investors focused on the Fed's updated dot plot, which showed that nine of 18 policymakers now anticipate higher interest rates in 2026.
